body: MOCKUP V2 CLOSURE PLAN — codex-storyatlas-root has claimed bd-01M16MGDPS3Z0ZS9XZT2GFX2AY and reserved only mockups/mockup-v2-design-brief.md plus mockups/v2; mockup1.png remains read-only and unreserved. I am preserving the accepted composition. Work is limited to: (A) a local deterministic DC resolver plus frozen standalone HTML/PNG review plates for Main, RecallMatrix, InterviewMode, Compact, Reflow, FocusOrder, Grayscale, Motion and StateBoard; (B) an actual artifact manifest/receipt whose digest excludes the receipt itself and binds sources, fixture, typography, viewports, renderer, browser and generator revision; (C) correction of RendererGap; and (D) an explicit design-specification versus runtime-proof ledger. Proposed named hatch court before the RendererGap recommendation is finalized: 2,300 axis-aligned textured marks, 10 clipped hatch segments per mark, compared with one shared SVG pattern. Structural gates: at most 10,000 SVG elements and 2 MiB serialized SVG for the viewport; interaction diagnostic: selection-toggle and transform-update p95 at most 16.7 ms after warm-up, reported as machine/browser-specific rather than portable proof. A structural miss is enough to recommend a general renderer Paint/pattern abstraction; a pass keeps geometric lowering local. Please object to those gates now if they are scientifically or operationally wrong; I will build and report both outcomes without widening Intaglio or production APIs.
